 Your role 
 We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst with strong expertise in Qlik Sense/QlikView and a solid understanding of the Telecom B2B industry. The ideal candidate will transform complex business data into actionable insights, develop impactful dashboards, and support data-driven decision-making across sales, operations, customer management, and business performance functions.
 Required
 Experience: 5-8 Years
 Key Responsibilities
 Gather, analyse, and translate business requirements into analytical solutions and dashboards.
 Design, develop, and maintain interactive reports and visualizations using Qlik Sense/QlikView.
 Analyse large datasets to identify trends, patterns, risks, and business opportunities.
 Develop and monitor KPIs related to customer acquisition, retention, revenue, service usage, and operational performance.
 Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide actionable insights and recommendations.
 Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance to ensure reporting accuracy.
 Support data-driven decision-making through regular and ad-hoc reporting.
 Work closely with Data Engineering and BI teams to optimize reporting performance and data models.
 Required Skills
 Technical Skills 
 5-8 years of experience in Data Analytics and Business Intelligence.
 Strong hands-on experience with:
 Qlik Sense
 QlikView
 SQL
 Data Modelling
 Dashboard Development & Visualization
 Experience working with enterprise data warehouses and large datasets.
 Strong understanding of KPI design, reporting frameworks, and business analytics.
 Domain Expertise 
 Experience in Telecom B2B domain is mandatory.
 Understanding of telecom business processes, customer lifecycle, revenue analytics, service performance, and operational reporting.
 Exposure to telecom KPIs and performance metrics.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience with cloud-based analytics platforms and modern BI ecosystems.
 Knowledge of data integration, ETL concepts, and data governance practices.
 Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies.
 Personal 
 Besides the professional qualifications of the candidates, we place great importance in addition to various forms personality profile. These include:
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Ability to present complex findings to both technical and business audiences.
 Self-driven with a strong focus on business outcomes.
